bound.fault_model: single-cycle bit flip of any gate output or flop Q

note: BOUNDED, NOT UNBOUNDED: verdict holds only for <= 2 single-cycle bit-flip faults (gate outputs and flop Q) within 8 cycles on this synthesized netlist. It says nothing about more faults, longer runs, other fault types (stuck-at, multi-bit/spatial, clock/voltage effects), or physical feasibility. Toy design; modelled faults.

explanation.summary: MINIMUM ATTACK COST = 2 faults (`$abc$275$new_n58_`@0, `$abc$275$new_n74_`@0). No single net decides, but the faults found hit independent redundant copies; the attacker needs 2 coordinated single-cycle flips (spanning 1 distinct cycle(s)).
explanation.fix_pattern: Raise the cost above the attacker's fault budget: add another independent copy (so quorum needs >2), keep every copy's result in its own disjoint output bits, and add a sticky alarm on any disagreement. Re-run the tool at k=2.
